table.name: leagues
table.purpose: Lookup table of football (soccer) leagues; each row is one league, identified by an id that other tables reference, with its home country. The id values match those used in t02 (which adds league names), and t03 references this table's ids.

col_001.name: league_id
col_001.description: Primary key identifying a football league. Values (e.g. 1729 = England Premier League, 7809 = Germany 1. Bundesliga, 17642 = Portugal Liga ZON Sagres, 21518 = Spain LIGA BBVA, 24558 = Switzerland Super League, per the t02 lookup) are the well-known league ids used in public football datasets. Referenced by t03 and joined one-to-one to t02.col_001, which carries the league name.

col_002.name: country
col_002.description: Name of the country where the league is based (e.g. England, Germany, Portugal, Spain, Switzerland, Belgium, France, Italy, Netherlands). One distinct value per league row.

table.name: League
table.purpose: Lookup table of football (soccer) leagues: one row per league, with an id and the league's full name (country + league name). Referenced by t03 (matches) and mirrors ids from t01 (countries).

col_001.name: league_id
col_001.description: Primary key of the league table; unique integer identifier per league. Referenced by t03 (match data).

col_002.name: country_id
col_002.description: Foreign key to t01.col_001 (countries). Values equal col_001 in every sample row, and the lookup pairs map to country names (England, Germany, Portugal, Spain, Switzerland), indicating each league id is aligned with its country id.

col_003.name: league_name
col_003.description: Full league name combining country and league, e.g. 'England Premier League', 'Germany 1. Bundesliga', 'Belgium Jupiler League'.

table.name: Match
table.purpose: One row per soccer (football) match: teams, league, season, score, lineups with player coordinates and ratings, per-match event XML, and pre-match betting odds from multiple bookmakers. This is the Match table of the European Soccer Database (Kaggle), with dates shifted ~58 years into the future for anonymization.

col_001.name: match_id
col_001.description: Synthetic primary key of the match row (1..25979).

col_002.name: country_id
col_002.description: Foreign key to the country table (t01); e.g. 1729=England, 21518=Spain, 24558=Switzerland.

col_003.name: league_id
col_003.description: Foreign key to the league table (t02); e.g. 1729=England Premier League, 21518=Spain LIGA BBVA. Values coincide with country_id because each league maps 1:1 to a country in this dataset.

col_005.name: stage
col_005.description: Matchweek / round number within the season (1-38).

col_006.name: match_date
col_006.description: Kickoff date (timestamp). Values fall in 2064-2072, i.e. real dates shifted ~58 years forward for anonymization; the true range is roughly 2008-2016.

table.name: players
table.purpose: One row per football player, with identifiers, name, contract date, height and weight. Sample names (Anthony Martial, Chris Killen) and metric body measurements strongly indicate a soccer player registry.

col_001.name: player_id
col_001.description: Primary key of the table; sequential surrogate identifier (1..11075) for each player row. Referenced by many columns in t03, t05 and t07, which appear to be per-player attribute tables.

col_002.name: player_external_id
col_002.description: A second unique per-player identifier (values like 100033, 289137), distinct from col_001 and also unique across all rows. Referenced by t03/t05 columns, so it is an alternate key, likely an ID from an external source system.

col_003.name: player_name
col_003.description: Player's display name, mostly unique; values like 'Anthony Martial', 'Cristian Hidalgo', 'Kiko' are footballer names. Nicknames (Kiko, Paulinho) occur, explaining the few duplicates.

col_004.name: player_alt_id
col_004.description: Another unique integer identifier per player (range 2..234141), referenced by t05.col_002. Its meaning beyond being an alternate unique key is unclear; could be an ID in a related dataset (e.g. a person or squad-system ID).

col_005.name: contract_end_date
col_005.description: A future-looking date (2023-2055, mostly 2030s-2040s) per player. The forward-shifted range suggests a contract expiry date rather than birth date; however, without corroborating columns this reading is not certain (it could be any planned future event date).

col_006.name: height_cm
col_006.description: Player height in centimetres (157.48-208.28, mean ~182). Values are inch-converted multiples (182.88 = 6'0"), typical of football player height data.

col_007.name: weight_kg
col_007.description: Player weight in kilograms (117-243, mean ~168), consistent with athlete body weight. It also matches keys in t03/t05/t07 col_001, but that is likely coincidental overlap of small integers rather than a real reference.

table.purpose: Each row appears to be an observation of an event (possibly a match/game or session) identified by two entity references (col_002, col_003), a date, a side (left/right), two categorical levels, and ~35 numeric measures mostly in the 1-97 range plus five small counts (1-15). The exact domain cannot be determined from this table alone; the many 1-97 integer columns resemble scores, ratings or percentile measures, and col_038-042 resemble small event counts (e.g. fouls/turnovers/goals). Marked tentative overall because the evidence does not pin down the subject matter. Note: the joins of col_005/col_006/col_010-042 to t03.col_001/t04.col_001/t07.col_001 are almost certainly spurious coincidences of small-integer ranges, not real foreign keys.

col_001.name: row_id
col_001.description: Synthetic primary key, sequential 1..183978, one per row. Referenced one-to-one by t06.col_001 and by many columns of t03/t04/t07 (those latter joins are likely coincidental value overlaps).

col_002.name: entity_a_id
col_002.description: Foreign key to t04.col_004. ~11k distinct values, so it identifies a repeating entity (e.g. a team/player/club) that occurs on ~17 rows on average. Exact meaning depends on t04.

col_003.name: entity_b_id
col_003.description: Foreign key to t04.col_002, a second repeating entity per row (e.g. opponent or counterpart). ~11k distinct values. Exact meaning depends on t04.

col_004.name: event_date
col_004.description: Date of the event/observation, ranging 2063-02-22 to 2072-07-07 (future-shifted dates, likely anonymized/offset real dates). 197 distinct dates.

col_007.name: side
col_007.description: Binary category 'right' (75%) / 'left' (25%); plausibly home/away side or handedness, but the evidence does not distinguish these.

col_008.name: level_1
col_008.description: Categorical level: medium (68%), high (23%), low (5%), plus noise values ('None', 'norm', 'stoc', 'le'). Likely a three-level intensity/classification with dirty values; exact meaning unknown.

col_009.name: level_2
col_009.description: Categorical level: medium (71%), high (15%), low (10%), plus many noise tokens ('_0', digits, fragments). Likely a second three-level classification with dirty values; exact meaning unknown.

col_038.name: small_count_1
col_038.description: Small integer 1-94 but heavily concentrated at 1-15 (median 10). Likely a small event count (e.g. fouls, turnovers, goals) rather than a rating; exact meaning unknown.

col_039.name: small_count_2
col_039.description: Small integer concentrated at 1-15 (median 11); same family as col_038. Likely a small event count.

col_040.name: small_count_3
col_040.description: Small integer concentrated at 1-15 (median 12); same family as col_038. Likely a small event count.

col_041.name: small_count_4
col_041.description: Small integer concentrated at 1-15 (median 11); same family as col_038. Likely a small event count.

col_042.name: small_count_5
col_042.description: Small integer concentrated at 1-15 (median 11); same family as col_038. Likely a small event count.

table.name: football_clubs
table.purpose: Reference table of football (soccer) clubs, one row per club, with internal IDs, full club name, and a three-letter club code. Referenced by match/event data in t03 and linked one-to-one to t05.

col_001.name: club_id
col_001.description: Primary key of the table; unique internal identifier for each club. Referenced by many columns in t03 (match data) and one-to-one by t05.col_001, so it is the canonical club key used across the database.

col_002.name: club_id_alt
col_002.description: Second unique numeric identifier per club, also referenced by t03 (col_008/col_009). Likely an alternative/legacy club ID from the same source system (e.g. a different provider's club key). Exact provenance unresolved, but its role as a secondary unique club key is clear.

col_004.name: club_name
col_004.description: Full official club name (e.g. 'Siena', 'Hibernian', '1. FC Köln', 'Villarreal CF'). Nearly unique; a few names repeat (e.g. 'Polonia Bytom'), likely distinct clubs sharing a name or renamed clubs.

col_005.name: club_code
col_005.description: Three-letter uppercase club abbreviation (e.g. 'SIE' for Siena, 'HIB' for Hibernian, 'CES' for Cesena). Not strictly unique (259 distinct over 299 rows), so it is a display/abbreviation code rather than a key.

table.purpose: One row per team-match tactical/rating record (likely football/soccer): a team identifier, a match/season date, a set of 20-80 scale attribute ratings, and paired categorical tactical descriptors (tempo, pressing, width, defensive line, offside trap, organisation, aggression/risk, passing length). Dates in 2066-2071 suggest synthetic or offset data. Overall meaning of the table is tentative: the value patterns strongly support a team-tactics/match-attributes reading, but the opaque names prevent certainty about which entity each id refers to.

col_001.name: record_id
col_001.description: Primary key; sequential integer 1-1458, one per row. Referenced by many columns of t05 (and t03.col_005, t04.col_007), so this row is the parent entity of those tables.

col_002.name: team_id
col_002.description: Integer referencing t05.col_001 (many-to-one). 285 distinct values with a long tail up to ~112k. Likely the team this record describes; alternatively a league/competition id. Unresolved between these readings.

col_003.name: match_or_opponent_id
col_003.description: Integer referencing t05.col_001, t03.col_001 and t04.col_001. 288 distinct values, mostly clustered 1601-10235 with outliers to 274581. Could be an opponent/match id or a second team reference; the multi-table reference pattern suggests a match or opponent entity. Not enough evidence to fix the exact meaning.

col_004.name: match_date
col_004.description: Date with only 6 distinct values (2066-02-22 to 2071-09-10), each covering ~240 rows; looks like a season/matchday date (Feb and Sep dates suggest season starts). Future-dated, so likely synthetic or shifted. Tentative: could be a season identifier rather than an actual match date.

col_005.name: overall_rating
col_005.description: Integer 20-80, ~57 distinct values, mean ~52. Reads as an overall attribute rating on a 20-80 scale (FIFA-style). Joins to id columns of t03/t04/t05 are likely incidental numeric overlap, not real references.

col_006.name: tempo
col_006.description: Three values: Balanced (81%), Fast, Slow. Clearly a tempo/speed-of-play descriptor.

col_008.name: pressure_level
col_008.description: Little / Normal / Lots. A quantity/intensity descriptor, most plausibly pressing or workload intensity; which attribute it qualifies is unknown.

col_010.name: passing_length
col_010.description: Mixed / Short / Long. Clearly a passing-length (build-up style) descriptor.

col_011.name: structure_1
col_011.description: Organised (95%) / Free Form. A team-structure descriptor; plausibly attacking organisation. Which phase it describes is uncertain.

col_013.name: risk_level
col_013.description: Normal / Risky / Safe. A risk-taking descriptor (e.g. tackling or passing aggression).

col_018.name: structure_2
col_018.description: Organised (90%) / Free Form. Second organisation descriptor, likely the defensive phase if col_011 is the attacking phase (or vice versa); exact assignment unknown.

col_020.name: defensive_line
col_020.description: Medium / Deep / High. Clearly a defensive-line height descriptor.

col_022.name: pressing_style
col_022.description: Press (87%) / Double / Contain. Clearly a pressing/defending-out-of-possession style descriptor.

col_024.name: width
col_024.description: Normal / Wide / Narrow. Clearly a formation/attacking-width descriptor.

col_025.name: offside_trap
col_025.description: Cover (94%) / Offside Trap. Clearly a defensive-strategy descriptor: whether the team plays the offside trap or covers.
